_doc: Loot's numbers (docs/design/LOOT_DESIGN.md). Makes by level: Worn, Sound, Wrought, Legion, Heartwrought. A gear roll's tier at level L: Common = commonBase x commonFall^(L-1), Uncommon flat, Rare and Epic = base + per x L, Set and Legendary flat when one may fall there. The balance lab's to move.
_material: A carrier that drops no gear: its people's material, and old iron half the time (crafting's ask, to keep the forge's economy as measured).
_power: What a unit of each stat is worth to the power score (never shown): 'stat:kind', 'stat', or 'prefix.*'. Fractions are the stats' own (0.05 is 5%).
_sources: Each carrier's terms: the chance a roll is gear, the rolls (deep: more from the arena's third tier), the least tier of the first, how much likelier Rare and up and Legendary are, and the people's material always given.

watch_kit.name: The Watch's Kit
watch_kit.lore: Eleven men, a year unpaid, and every one of them still oils his mail.

bonuses.text: Standing still, you block a blow every six seconds, as a shield-wall does. The Watch takes you for one of its own

levy_red.name: The Levy Red
levy_red.lore: Red was a town's colour before it was a gang's. Nobody in the Roost will tell you which town.

bonuses.text: +6% critical chance; Kerchiefs take you for one of theirs
Your thrown and loosed skills fly one more; your critical strikes bleed
